description.content:
Get a list of all the Lukka normalized assets with details.

 Response Details 

 
 
 
 Field Name 
 Data Type 
 Data Type Details 
 Description 
 
 
 lukka_id 
 CHARACTER 
 11 
 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the crypto asset. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information 
 
 
 lukka_asset_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Lukka normalized unique asset code (ticker) 
 
 
 lukka_asset_name 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Lukka's long name for the asset 
 
 
 whitepaper_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Ticker of the crypto asset found in the primary source 
 
 
 asset_type 
 CHARACTER 
 20 
 Type of crypto asset such as coin, token, stablecoin, etc. 
 
 
 asset_website 
 CHARACTER 
 4000 
 Official website of the asset or primary source of asset information 
 
 
 blockchain 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Blockchain on which the asset resides
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Get the cross reference of all the current assets supported by an entity mapped to Lukka normalized assets.

 Response Details 

 
 
 
 Field Name 
 Data Type 
 Data Type Details 
 Description 
 
 
 entity_name 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Name of the source entity 
 
 
 entity_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Unique Lukka code (ticker) for the source entity 
 
 
 entity_type 
 CHARACTER 
 20 
 Type of service provided by the source entity 
 
 
 entity_asset_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Asset code (ticker) provided by the source entity 
 
 
 entity_asset_name 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Asset name provided by the source entity 
 
 
 entity_asset_internal_id 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Internal code provided by the source entity to uniquely identify the asset 
 
 
 entity_withdrawal_fee_asset_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Asset code (ticker) of the fee charged by the source entity when withdrawing the asset 
 
 
 entity_withdrawal_fee_amount 
 NUMERIC 
 
 Amount of fee charged by the source entity when withdrawing the asset 
 
 
 entity_withdrawal_fee_type 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Indicates if the withdrawal fee charged is a percentage or unit 
 
 
 lukka_asset_id 
 CHARACTER 
 11 
 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the crypto asset. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information 
 
 
 lukka_asset_code 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Lukka normalized unique asset code (ticker) 
 
 
 lukka_asset_name 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Lukka's long name for the asset 
 
 
 start_time 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity asset was mapped to the Lukka asset 
 
 
 end_time 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity stopped supporting the asset; also indicates the time when the entity to Lukka asset mapping was removed
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

description.content:
Lukka Reference Data v1 - a security master of standardized crypto asset data: the Lukka normalized asset master plus active, historical, newly added and newly deleted asset and pair cross-reference mappings per source entity.

Contact Support:
 Name: Lukka Reference Data Support
 Email: support_refdata@lukka.tech
